scientific_integrity: Counts are reproducible by deterministic exact-integer exhaustive verifier; published inversion and Gauss-sum theory credited; no assertion of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to simple cubic graphs on exactly eight vertices. Not a proof of general subcubic-support conjecture or a full eight-vertex classification. Previously unlocated equivalent computations possible; the 2019 draft and 2026 paper were not fully inspected.
title: Exactly two cubic eight-vertex graph types survive the elliptic Arf edge transform
